Evidence: Pakistan ka itihas 1947 mein Bharat ke partition se shuru hota hai, jab Muslim-majority state banayi gayi thi. Yeh do hisson mein thi, jo 1971 mein East Pakistan ke Bangladesh banne ke saath alag ho gayi. Pakistan ki vikas mein Islamist violence aur arthik rukawat aati rahi hain, aur India ke saath sambandh aksar tanav bhare rahte hain (Source 1).
Justification: Claim ke anusar, Pakistan wale apne hain aur unka koyla ko doodh se dhone par bhi safeed nahi hoga, jo ki unki asli soorat ko darshata hai. Lekin, retrieved evidence mein Pakistan ke vikas aur sambandhon ki samasyaon ka zikr hai, jo is claim ko contradict karta hai. Pakistan ki asli sthiti aur samasyaon ko samajhne par yeh claim sahi nahi lagta, isliye yeh refute hota hai.
